paragraphs.en: Your agent can write code, but ECC gives it a coordinated engineering system and toolbox: it plans before it builds, verifies changes with tests, reviews its own work from a fresh context, remembers what matters, and turns repeated wins into reusable skills and workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 你的智能体可以编写代码，但 ECC 为它提供了一套协同的工程系统和工具箱：它会在构建之前先做规划，用测试验证更改，从全新的上下文审查自己的工作，记住重要的内容，并将反复成功的经验转化为可复用的技能和工作流。

paragraphs.en: plan -> test -> implement -> review -> verify -> remember -> improve Instead of rebuilding that process in every prompt, you install it once and make it part of how your agent works.
paragraphs.zh: plan -> test -> implement -> review -> verify -> remember -> improve 与其在每次提示中重新构建这一流程，不如一次性安装它，让它成为智能体工作方式的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Optimize the context window. Persist everything else.
paragraphs.zh: 优化上下文窗口。持久化其余所有内容。

paragraphs.en: ECC is MIT-licensed open source. It works best with Claude Code today, has native Codex and Qoder plugin paths, and provides capability-limited adapters for Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Qwen, and other harnesses. See the support status matrix before assuming feature parity.
paragraphs.zh: ECC 是采用 MIT 许可证的开源项目。 它目前与 Claude Code 配合效果最佳，提供原生的 Codex 和 Qoder 插件路径，并为 Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini、Zed、GitHub Copilot、Antigravity、Qwen 等其他运行环境提供功能受限的适配器。 在假设功能完全对等之前，请先查看支持状态矩阵。

paragraphs.en: For Claude Code plugin setup, updates, scope changes, and hook-profile changes:
paragraphs.zh: 关于 Claude Code 插件的设置、更新、范围变更以及钩子配置文件的变更：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup Windows first-time walkthrough If you are new to command-line tools, use this copy-and-paste path:
paragraphs.zh: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup Windows 首次使用指南 如果您是命令行工具的新手，请按照以下复制粘贴路径操作：

paragraphs.en: Install Node.js 18 or newer, Git, and Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: 安装 Node.js 18 或更高版本、Git 以及 Claude Code。

paragraphs.en: Open PowerShell from the Windows Start menu.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Windows 开始菜单打开 PowerShell。

paragraphs.en: Confirm that each prerequisite is available:
paragraphs.zh: 确认每项前提条件都已就绪：

paragraphs.en: node -- version git -- version claude -- version Run the guided installer:
paragraphs.zh:
```
node --version
git --version
claude --version
```

运行引导式安装程序：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc - universal @2 .2.3 setup For a typical personal setup, choose Global user , choose Standard hooks, and confirm.
paragraphs.zh: npx ecc - universal @2 .2.3 setup 对于典型的个人设置，请选择 Global user，选择 Standard hooks，然后确认。

paragraphs.en: Start a new Claude Code session and run /plugin list to verify that ecc@ecc is enabled.
paragraphs.zh: 开始一个新的 Claude Code 会话并运行 /plugin list 以验证 ecc@ecc 已启用。

paragraphs.en: This path does not require cloning the repository. If any prerequisite command is not found, install or repair that prerequisite before rerunning ECC setup.
paragraphs.zh: 此路径不需要克隆仓库。 如果未找到任何前置条件命令，请在重新运行 ECC 设置之前安装或修复该前置条件。

paragraphs.en: The wizard inventories the official marketplace and every native Claude install scope before making changes, then installs, updates, or safely moves ecc@ecc to the scope you choose. Rerun the same command whenever you want to update ECC, change scope, or change its hook profile. This setup wizard currently configures the Claude Code plugin; use the multi-harness wizard below for Codex or Kimi Code.
paragraphs.zh: 向导在进行任何更改之前，会先清点官方插件市场和所有本地 Claude 安装作用域，然后在您选择的作用域中安装、更新或安全迁移 ecc@ecc。 任何时候您想更新 ECC、更换作用域或更改其钩子配置，都可以重新运行同一条命令。 此安装向导目前仅配置 Claude Code 插件；如需配置 Codex 或 Kimi Code，请使用下方的多框架向导。

paragraphs.en: To configure more than one coding agent in one reviewed flow, use the multi-harness wizard:
paragraphs.zh: 要在同一个评审流程中配置多个编码智能体，请使用多工具向导：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided It lets you select any combination of Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi Code, shows each install channel and destination, preflights every selection before the first write, and asks for one final confirmation.
paragraphs.zh: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided 它可以让你任意组合选择 Claude Code、Codex 和 Kimi Code，显示每个安装渠道和目标位置，在首次写入之前对每个选择进行预检，并请求最终确认。

paragraphs.en: For automation, make every provider-specific choice explicit:
paragraphs.zh: 在自动化中，请将每一个特定于提供商的选择都显式化：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided \ --harness claude --harness codex --harness kimi \ --claude-scope local --claude-hooks standard \ --profile core --yes Verify the native guided Codex path and managed Kimi path without writing first:
paragraphs.zh: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided \ --harness claude --harness codex --harness kimi \ --claude-scope local --claude-hooks standard \ --profile core --yes 在首次写入之前，先验证原生的引导式 Codex 路径和托管的 Kimi 路径：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided --harness codex --dry-run npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --profile core --target kimi --dry-run Additional package-name commands are also available through the 2.2 alias:
paragraphs.zh: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --guided --harness codex --dry-run npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --profile core --target kimi --dry-run 还可以通过 2.2 别名使用其他包名命令：

paragraphs.en: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 consult " security reviews " --target claude npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 install --profile minimal --target claude --with capability:machine-learning npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 doctor --target kimi Do not use npx ecc-install --profile minimal --target claude : ecc-install is a binary name inside ecc-universal , not a separately published npm package.

paragraphs.en: ECC also ships advanced managed adapters for cursor , antigravity , gemini , opencode , codebuddy , joycode , qwen , zed , hermes , and openclaw . paragraphs.en: Do not stack install methods. Installing ECC twice into the same harness can duplicate skills, commands, hooks, or configuration; installing it once into multiple harnesses does not.
paragraphs.zh: 不要叠加多种安装方式。 将 ECC 安装到同一个运行环境两次，可能会导致技能、命令、钩子或配置被重复；而将其安装到多个不同的运行环境中则不会。

sents.en: Do not stack install methods.

sents.en: Installing ECC twice into the same harness can duplicate skills, commands, hooks, or configuration; installing it once into multiple harnesses does not.

paragraphs.en: If you already layered multiple installs and things look duplicated, skip straight to Reset / Uninstall ECC .
paragraphs.zh: 如果已经叠加了多次安装并且出现重复内容，请直接跳到重置 / 卸载 ECC。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively, run Claude Code's native plugin commands inside Claude Code:
paragraphs.zh: 或者，在 Claude Code 内部运行 Claude Code 的原生插件命令：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC /plugin install ecc@ecc The native path installs ECC's skills, agents, commands, and plugin-managed hooks. If you choose it, stop there. Do not also run a full manual install into Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC /plugin install ecc@ecc 原生路径会安装 ECC 的技能、智能体、命令以及插件管理的钩子。 如果你选择这种方式，到此为止即可。 不要再向 Claude Code 运行完整的手动安装。

sents.en: If you choose it, stop there.
sents.zh: 如果你选择这种方式，到此为止即可。

sents.en: Do not also run a full manual install into Claude Code.
sents.zh: 不要再向 Claude Code 运行完整的手动安装。

paragraphs.en: This is intentional. Anthropic marketplace/plugin installs are keyed by a canonical plugin identifier, so ECC uses ecc@ecc to keep tool names and slash-command namespaces short enough for strict Desktop/API validators. Older posts may still show the former long marketplace identifier; treat that as a legacy alias only. Separately, the npm package stayed on ecc-universal , so npm installs and marketplace installs intentionally use different names.
paragraphs.zh: 这是有意为之。 Anthropic 的 marketplace/plugin 安装以规范化的插件标识符作为键，因此 ECC 使用 ecc@ecc，以使工具名称和斜杠命令命名空间足够短，从而通过严格的 Desktop/API 校验器。 较早的帖子可能仍显示原先较长的 marketplace 标识符；请仅将其视为遗留别名。 此外，npm 包仍保留为 ecc-universal，因此 npm 安装和 marketplace 安装有意识地使用了不同的名称。

See the .qoder-plugin notes for the exact boundary.

paragraphs.en: Claude manual installs place each skill directly under ~/.claude/skills/<skill-name>/ (or .claude/skills/<skill-name>/ for claude-project ) so Claude Code can discover it. When upgrading an older ECC manual install, the installer migrates only nested skills/ecc/ files recorded in ECC install-state. If a flat skill directory is user-owned, ECC preserves it, prints a conflict warning, and keeps any older managed copy tracked for a safe uninstall instead of overwriting user files.
For the normal core profile with hooks disabled:
./install.sh --profile core --without baseline:hooks --target claude ./install.sh --profile core --no-hooks --target claude Add the hook runtime later only if you want it:

./install.sh --target claude --modules hooks-runtime --enable-hooks Any install whose profile or modules would materialize the hook runtime requires an explicit decision. Without --enable-hooks or --no-hooks , the installer prints what the hooks can do and stops before writing anything. The guided installer ( ecc install --guided ) asks for this choice interactively.
Ask the packaged advisor which components match your work:

node scripts/ecc.js consult " security reviews " --target claude It returns matching components, related profiles, and preview/install commands. Use the preview command before installing if you want to inspect the exact file plan.
You can also install explicit skills or capabilities:

./install.sh --target claude --skills tdd-workflow,security-review node scripts/ecc.js install --profile minimal --target claude --with capability:machine-learning Manual component-by-component copying also works. Each component is fully independent:
paragraphs.zh: ./install.sh --target claude --skills tdd-workflow,security-review node scripts/ecc.js install --profile minimal --target claude --with capability:machine-learning 也可以手动逐个组件复制。 每个组件都是完全独立的：

自托管模型与自定义端点

paragraphs.en: ecc ito delegates to the separately installed canonical Itô client; ECC does not maintain a second API client. ecc ito login [--no-browser] performs device authorization, opens the Itô verification page by default, and persists a device token in macOS Keychain; --no-browser suppresses the page handoff. ECC itself does no browser automation. ecc ito auth is validation-only and rejects --no-browser . The available operations are ecc ito login , ecc ito auth , ecc ito find , ecc ito status , and the separately gated ecc ito evals . The matching MCP tools remain ito_auth , ito_find , and ito_status ; ito_auth validates existing credentials and node qualification is CLI-only.

paragraphs.en: The ito-compute-cli package is currently unpublished. Build it locally from the Itô runtime repo (private while the desk hardens; design partners get access) under cli/ito-compute-cli , run npm ci and npm run check , then set ECC_ITO_CLI_EXECUTABLE to that build's absolute dist/bin/ito.js path. Login never inherits ITO_API_KEY ; auth, find, and status forward ITO_API_KEY directly when configured, and ITO_AUTH_MODE=legacy is not required. ecc ito logout revokes the current device credential and retains its local copy if remote revocation cannot be confirmed. Device tokens use macOS Keychain by default; explicit file fallback must retain owner-only directory/file permissions. ECC does not discover this credential-bearing client through PATH . See the ito-compute skill for the full RFQ authority and MCP setup contract.
paragraphs.zh: ito-compute-cli 软件包目前尚未发布。 在 Itô 运行时仓库中从本地构建该包（在桌面团队加固期间仓库为私有；设计合作伙伴可获得访问权限）的 cli/ito-compute-cli 目录下，运行 npm ci 和 npm run check，然后将 ECC_ITO_CLI_EXECUTABLE 设置为该构建的 dist/bin/ito.js 绝对路径。 登录永远不会继承 ITO_API_KEY；在已配置的情况下，auth、find 和 status 命令会直接转发 ITO_API_KEY，且无需设置 ITO_AUTH_MODE=legacy。ecc ito logout 会撤销当前设备的凭据，如果无法确认远程撤销成功，则会保留其本地副本。 设备令牌默认使用 macOS 钥匙串；显式的文件回退方案必须保留仅所有者可访问的目录/文件权限。 ECC 不会通过 PATH 发现这个携带凭据的客户端。 完整的 RFQ 权限与 MCP 设置契约请参阅 ito-compute 技能文档。

paragraphs.en: The Memory Vault stores portable ecc.memory.v1 Markdown documents instead of copying vendor transcripts or emailing context between agents. Project memories are protected by a fail-closed .gitignore ; use the team scope only for human-inspected, version-controlled sharing. Team memories remain unreviewed context even after they are committed.
paragraphs.zh: Memory Vault（记忆保险库）存储可移植的 ecc.memory.v1 Markdown 文档，而不是在智能体之间复制厂商的会话记录或通过邮件传递上下文。 项目记忆受到 fail-closed 的 .gitignore 保护；团队范围仅用于经过人工检查、纳入版本控制的共享。 团队记忆即使在被提交之后，仍然是未经审查的上下文。

paragraphs.en: After installing the runtime above, check that the CLI and optional MCP entry point are available:
paragraphs.zh: 在安装上述运行时之后，请检查 CLI 和可选的 MCP 入口点是否可用：

paragraphs.en: ecc memory --help command -v ecc-memory-mcp # Initialize the project vault. ecc memory init --scope project # Write a handoff body to a regular file, then target the next harness. ecc memory handoff \ --from hermes \ --target codex \ --title " Continue authentication migration " \ --body-file ./handoff.md # Recall it from another harness. ecc memory search " authentication migration " --target-harness codex ecc memory read < memory-id > # Validate the vault before sharing team memories. ecc memory doctor Memory bodies are accepted only through --stdin or --body-file , not as command-line values. The first release keeps every vault entry unreviewed and create-only; human review promotes accepted knowledge into governed project documentation rather than changing memory trust. Normal search recall returns active project and team memories. A direct ID read may inspect a non-active entry. User-scope recall must be requested explicitly. Agents must verify important claims against authoritative sources and must never treat recalled bodies as executable instructions or policy.
paragraphs.zh: ecc memory --help command -v ecc-memory-mcp # 初始化项目库。ecc memory init --scope project # 将交接正文写入常规文件，然后指定下一个框架。ecc memory handoff \ --from hermes \ --target codex \ --title " 继续身份验证迁移 " \ --body-file ./handoff.md # 从另一个框架中召回它。ecc memory search " 身份验证迁移 " --target-harness codex ecc memory read < memory-id > # 在共享团队记忆之前校验库。ecc memory doctor 记忆正文仅接受通过 --stdin 或 --body-file 提供的内容，不接受作为命令行参数值。 首个发布版本将所有库条目保持为未审核且仅可创建的状态；人工审核将已接受的知识提升为受治理的项目文档，而不改变记忆的信任级别。 常规搜索召回返回处于活动状态的项目和团队记忆。 通过 ID 直接读取可以查看非活动状态的条目。 用户范围的召回必须显式请求。 智能体必须对照权威来源核实重要声明，并且绝不能将召回的正文视为可执行指令或策略。

paragraphs.en: For opt-in MCP access, add the ecc-memory-vault entry from mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json to each harness that needs it, then run ecc-memory-mcp . The server exposes only memory_save , memory_search , memory_read , and memory_doctor . Each server must launch with a lowercase ECC_MEMORY_HARNESS identity; the identity is server-bound and cannot be supplied by a tool caller. User scope additionally requires the operator-controlled ECC_MEMORY_ALLOW_USER_SCOPE=1 opt-in. See skills/unified-memory/SKILL.md for the workflow and trust boundaries, and docs/design/ecc-memory-vault.md for the capability contract.
paragraphs.zh: 如需选择性启用 MCP 访问，请将 mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json 中的 ecc-memory-vault 条目添加到每个需要它的 harness，然后运行 ecc-memory-mcp 。 该服务器仅暴露 memory_save 、 memory_search 、 memory_read 和 memory_doctor 。 每个服务器必须以小写的 ECC_MEMORY_HARNESS 身份启动；该身份与服务器绑定，不能由工具调用方提供。 用户范围还需要由操作者控制的 ECC_MEMORY_ALLOW_USER_SCOPE=1 选择性启用。 工作流程和信任边界参见 skills/unified-memory/SKILL.md ，能力契约参见 docs/design/ecc-memory-vault.md 。

paragraphs.en: The plugin automatically detects your preferred package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn, or bun) with the following priority:
paragraphs.zh: 该插件会自动检测您偏好的包管理器（npm、pnpm、yarn 或 bun），优先级如下：

paragraphs.en: # Via environment variable export CLAUDE_PACKAGE_MANAGER=pnpm # Via global config node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --global pnpm # Via project config node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --project bun # Detect current setting node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --detect Or use the /setup-pm command.
paragraphs.zh: # 通过环境变量 export CLAUDE_PACKAGE_MANAGER=pnpm # 通过全局配置 node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --global pnpm # 通过项目配置 node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --project bun # 检测当前设置 node scripts/setup-package-manager.js --detect 或者使用 /setup-pm 命令。

paragraphs.en: Use runtime flags to tune strictness or disable specific hooks temporarily:
paragraphs.zh: 使用运行时标志（runtime flags）来调整严格程度，或临时禁用特定的钩子（hooks）：

paragraphs.en: # Hook strictness profile (default: standard) export ECC_HOOK_PROFILE=standard # Comma-separated hook IDs to disable export ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS= " pre:bash:tmux-reminder,post:edit:typecheck " # Cap SessionStart additional context (default: 8000 chars) export ECC_SESSION_START_MAX_CHARS=4000 # Disable SessionStart additional context entirely for low-context/local-model setups export ECC_SESSION_START_CONTEXT=off # Session-tmp retention window in days (default: 30). # Set to 0, off, false, disabled, never, or none to keep all sessions (disable pruning). export ECC_SESSION_RETENTION_DAYS=14 # Cap how many learned instincts SessionStart injects into context (default: 6) export ECC_MAX_INJECTED_INSTINCTS=6 # Minimum confidence an instinct needs to be injected, 0-1 (default: 0.7) export ECC_INSTINCT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.7 # SessionStart ranks injected instincts by confidence + project/stack relevance # (default: on). Project-scoped instincts, and instincts whose domain/trigger # matches the detected stack (languages, frameworks, plus terraform/dbt markers), # get a small ranking boost so they surface above unrelated higher-confidence # ones. Set to off/false/0/no to rank by confidence alone. export ECC_INSTINCT_RELEVANCE_RANKING=on # Keep context/scope/loop warnings but suppress API-rate cost estimates export ECC_CONTEXT_MONITOR_COST_WARNINGS=off Windows PowerShell:

paragraphs.en: Cursor has more hook events than Claude Code (20 vs 8). The .cursor/hooks/adapter.js module transforms Cursor's stdin JSON to Claude Code's format, allowing existing scripts/hooks/*.js to be reused without duplication. paragraphs.en: agentshield scan --path . Report a vulnerability. Use the private process in SECURITY.md (GitHub private vulnerability reporting). Please do not open public issues for security reports. Built-in guardrails. GateGuard gates destructive shell commands (including rm , force/path git checkout , and destructive find -exec ) before they run; the supply-chain IOC scanner runs in CI; and AgentShield audits your own agent, hook, MCP, permission, and secret surfaces ( /security-scan ). Hooks, MCP servers, and context controls Hooks can run shell commands, MCP servers can hold credentials, and project instructions can enter an agent's context. Treat all three as executable configuration.
